tex_content.html:
If complete pointed manifolds with $\Phi $-almost nonnegative curvature, rescaled by $Q_k\to \infty $, converge smoothly, then the limit has nonnegative sectional curvature.
Proof

↗ def:kl-canonical-neighborhood-theorem-almost-nonnegative-curvature \sketch If the approximating scalar curvatures stay bounded, (156) makes the rescaled curvature vanish. If they diverge, write $Q_k^{-1}\Rm =(Q_k^{-1}R)(\Rm /R)$ and use $\Rm /R\geq -\Phi (R)/R\to 0$.

□
Theorem
[compactness for canonical neighborhoods]
